question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech. **

You said, “I will bake a walnut cake.”

options.text: I said that you will bake a walnut cake.
You said that you will bake a walnut cake.
You said that you would bake a walnut cake.
You told that you would baked a walnut cake.

solution:
The correct answer is:** You said that you would bake a walnut cake. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is a direct speech and we need to convert it into an indirect speech.
 
• 
 
When we change an direct speech to an indirect speech, we must follow these **rules:****​**

 
 
• ​The reporting verb **'said'** remains unchanged.
 
• The **inverted commas ("...") is replaced with the conjunction 'that'** to show the indirect speech part.
 
• The modal verb** 'will' **changes to **'would'**
 
• The** 'I' **changes to the pronoun** 'You'**
 
 
 
• **​Example - **
 
 
• **​***The author said to the publisher, “I shall give you my best work. (Direct)*
 
• *The author told the publisher that he would give him his best work. (Indirect)*
 
 

Thus, **option 3 i**s the correct answer.

**Hence, The indirect speech is -** *You said that you would bake a walnut cake. *
